title: acp/1 hand-raise
description: Modeled directly on the `HandRaise` sketch in docs/agent-communication-protocol.md ('Floor control'): participant, reason, urgency, in_reply_to. Implemented as of M2.6 by agent-comms/src/acp/floor.py's `HandRaise`/`Reason` -- this schema is the single source of truth for both the wire shape and (via orchestrator's AnthropicHandRaiseScorer) the LLM's structured-output contract, read at runtime rather than duplicated. See agent-comms/tests/test_schemas.py's hand-raise section for the real-output validation and docs/decisions.md (2026-09-29) for the M2.6 gap closure.

reason.description: The doc's `Reason` StrEnum: ADDRESSED, NEW_POINT, DISAGREE, AGREE_PASS -- serialized here as their StrEnum values.
